name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager
summary: Customer Success Manager with 15+ years owning a book of business as the primary point of contact for SaaS and technology customers, driving renewal, adoption, and account growth. Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partner accounts at Birdeye and retained roughly 94% during tenure; at Wix, onboarded and launched 25+ clients monthly while holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets. Track every customer interaction and account update in Salesforce, monitor utilization to catch risk early, and partner closely with Sales to flag growth opportunities and support deal execution.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients on complex SaaS platforms, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals and drive them toward measurable outcomes.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand account scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, tracking client-level KPIs and account health.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping engagement records auditable across concurrent accounts.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and quarterly business reviews.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value and adopt new features.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
